title: Review comments in DCLab Code: comment on changed lines and send them to the agent as one message (parity B5), and page tests back in Chromium
request: The owner's goal (2026-10-26, before sleeping: continue non-stop, ask questions now): Claude Code and Codex desktop's capabilities in DCLab Code; parity B5. The owner allowed reinstalling Playwright's Chromium (page tests) and removing the stray main-product clone.
plan: map each diff line to its file and line
comment boxes on lines, a bar to send
one message to the agent and a review_comments record
tests, a page test in Chromium, a review

decisions.decision: The server builds the message from the comments (numbered, `file:line`, the line's code, the comment) and records them apart
decisions.why: one format the agent reads, and the person's review kept as their act for training

decisions.decision: A comment is matched to its line by file, side, line and the line's code; one whose line changed is listed as outdated
decisions.why: the agent's edits move lines while the person reviews

change: server/review.js, POST /api/sessions/:id/review, web/review.js diffLines and unquotePath, the comment UI in the Changes panel, docs/API.md; a page test for A3, A4 and B5 in Chromium.

findings.defect: a comment being typed was wiped while the agent worked
findings.scenario: about 0.7 s after the agent's next tool ended, loadDiff redrew the panel and the box and its text were gone
findings.cause: every tool end refreshes the diff
findings.fix: no redraw while a comment box has text or focus (the person's own actions force it)

findings.defect: line numbers went wrong after a removed '-- ' line
findings.scenario: a removed SQL comment '-- note' shows as '--- note' and was skipped as a header, so later removed lines were off by one
findings.fix: headers are read only outside a hunk

findings.defect: a non-ASCII file name became the whole header line
findings.scenario: git quotes names like "a/\330\247.py"; the agent was told `diff --git "a/…":3`
findings.cause: the path came from the diff --git line

findings.defect: comments to a session whose copy was gone were said sent and lost
findings.scenario: the route recorded the review and answered 202; the engine refused to send; the page cleared the comments
findings.cause: no check for a removed or failed copy

findings.defect: comments went stale when the diff changed
findings.scenario: after the agent's edit a comment sat under another line, or vanished from view while still counted
findings.cause: matched by file, side and line only
findings.fix: the line's code must match too; others are listed as outdated, removable
findings.test: (code; page test covers the shown case)

findings.defect: removed lines of a renamed file named the new file
findings.scenario: `new.py:12` (a removed line) where 12 is old.py's line
findings.cause: removed lines used the new path
findings.fix: removed lines use the old path

findings.scenario: the empty line after the diff and a binary file's line, with leftover counts
findings.cause: no hunk state, counters not reset
findings.fix: only lines inside a hunk; counters reset per file

findings.defect: a double click sent the review twice; a comment added meanwhile was lost
findings.scenario: two requests in flight; items cleared after the await
findings.fix: one send at a time; only the sent items are removed

findings.defect: the owner's app stayed with DCLab's tools off after a restart
findings.scenario: restarting the app on a loaded machine (load about 20): the standalone DCLab server took longer than the first look, and the app showed 'DCLab tools: 0' until refreshed by hand
findings.fix: while DCLab is not reachable the app looks again every 15 s (never starting a second server)

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every test passes, page tests included
measurements.result: 91 tests, all passed, none skipped (Chromium reinstalled); the new page test drives @, the File tab, the meter, a review comment and Fork

measurements.name: browser pane check
measurements.gate: a click on a changed line opens a box; the comment shows under it; the bar counts it
measurements.result: README.md:4 commented, bar '1 comment on the changes · Send to the agent · Clear'

outcome: A person reviews the agent's changes line by line and sends the comments as one message, as in Codex; the page tests run in real Chromium again.
lessons: A panel that refreshes on every agent step must never redraw over what the person is typing.
risks: a comment on a changed data file copies its row into the message (the person's choice, kept as the turn's prompt)
